_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The file editor serializes saves when switching files during an in-flight write. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a directory holding first.md ("# First") and second.md ("# Second"). The server's answer to the first save of first.md (POST /api/write-file) is held back until call "release"; call "first save started" says whether that save has arrived ("true" or "false"); call "first.md" says whether first.md on disk contains "Latest edit" ("true" or "false"). To "open F": press "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier (on whatever has focus); wait for the finder input ".grp-filter" to be visible; fill it with F; wait for the FIRST ".grp-row" to contain F (assert_text_contains on ".grp-row", which checks the first match: the finder lists every file until the query applies, and Enter opens the top row, so waiting for any row with the text is not enough); press Enter in the finder input; the dialog (role "dialog") whose accessible name matches the regular expression /Edit .*F/ is then "the modal" for F, and its ".monaco-editor" should become visible (up to 15s). "The preview" is the modal's region (role "region") named "Markdown preview". "The editor input" is the modal's ".monaco-editor textarea.inputarea"; to focus it, eval its focus(). Key presses go to whatever has focus; do not click anything to focus first unless a step says so. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open first.md. 3. Focus the editor input. 4. Press "End" with the Control modifier. 5. Type, key by key, "
## First edit" (the 
 presses Enter). 6. Call "first save started" until it returns "true": the first auto-save is now held at the network boundary. 7. Press "End" with the Control modifier. 8. Type, key by key, "
## Latest edit". 9. Press "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier, fill ".grp-filter" with "second.md", wait for the first ".grp-row" to contain "second.md", and press Enter in the finder input. 10. In the dialog whose accessible name matches /Edit .*second\.md/, ".monaco-editor" should be visible. 11. Press "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier, wait for ".grp-filter" to be visible, fill it with "first.md", wait for the first ".grp-row" to contain "first.md", and press Enter in the finder input. 12. The dialog whose accessible name matches /Edit .*first\.md/ ("the reopened modal") should be visible. 13. The reopened modal must hold exactly 0 ".monaco-editor" elements (it waits for the pending save). 14. Call "release". 15. The reopened modal's ".monaco-editor" should become visible. 16. Its ".view-lines" should contain "Latest edit". 17. Call "first.md" until it returns "true".
